name: RedSayra
description: Strawberry variety bred by Planasa. Per Fruitnet's reporting of Ifapa (Andalusian public agricultural research institute) data, RedSayra became Spain's most widely planted strawberry variety in the current season, positioning it as the leading cultivar in Huelva -- the dominant Spanish (and one of the dominant European) strawberry production regions.

attributes.geography_note: Huelva, Spain -- reported as Spain's most widely planted strawberry variety per Ifapa data
